summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing that its common shares began trading on Nasdaq on a 30:1 consolidated basis. The share consolidation reduced outstanding common shares from 18,567,650 to 618,899, with fractional shares rounded up if at least one-half or cancelled otherwise. The trading symbol IMCC remains unchanged, with new CUSIP/ISIN numbers assigned. Outstanding convertible securities were proportionately adjusted. Computershare, the transfer agent, mailed letters of transmittal to registered shareholders. No fractional shares were issued. Beneficial holders need no action; intermediaries handle processing. This consolidation is a reverse stock split aimed at maintaining listing compliance, with no deal terms or premium applicable.
